clue.text: Retribution seems in order

indicators.note: put in order: the letters of the two words are rearranged into a fresh sequence

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that paying people back seems only proper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' reads as one phrase meaning fitting, but 'in' is fodder and 'order' alone is the anagram signal on SEEMSIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesis is the goddess of vengeance, and by extension any deserved punishment or comeuppance.

clue.text: Head admits old student with expression of admiration

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so one piece takes the others inside

parts.note: a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness or Dungeness
L is a learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A headteacher lets in a former pupil, saying something complimentary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'admits' puts O and L inside NESS; a ness is a headland.
explanation.definitionFit: No less is said in admiring surprise, as in 'the Queen, no less'.

clue.text: Married girl from spite

parts.note: Alice is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A wife acting out of spite.
explanation.definitionFit: Malice is a desire to harm others, a synonym of spite.

clue.text: Needed to retaliate when opponent gets the first blow?

definitions.text: Needed to retaliate when opponent gets the first blow?

parts.words: Needed to retaliate when opponent gets the first blow?
parts.note: after the opponent's first blow one needs another one, a renewed burst of energy

explanation.surface: Advice on fighting back after being hit first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blow' suggests a punch, but here it is a puff of breath, so a later breath is what restores you.
explanation.definitionFit: A second wind is renewed energy that lets one continue after exhaustion.

clue.text: Take out and clean

definitions.meaning: to rub hard with a brush

explanation.definitionFit: To scrub is both to cancel a plan and to clean by hard rubbing.

clue.text: Clothing strike

definitions.meaning: informal word for clothes and gear
to hit someone hard, in slang

explanation.definitionFit: Clobber is British slang both for one's kit or clothes and, as a verb, for hitting hard.

clue.text: Look out, it may have a high tar content

definitions.text: it may have a high tar content
definitions.meaning: a tar is a sailor, often stationed high on the mast

explanation.definitionFit: A crow's nest is the lookout platform at the masthead, where a sailor keeps watch.

clue.text: Feathered, they skim the water

parts.note: rowers feather blades by turning them flat, not birds' plumage

explanation.definitionFit: Oars are feathered between strokes, turned flat so they pass over the water.

clue.text: Lie on bed, resolved to be extremely lazy

indicators.note: resolved means broken down and reformed, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone lazing in bed decides to do nothing at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Bone idle is an idiom meaning thoroughly lazy, idle to the bone.

clue.text: Appears on stage again, or makes another record

definitions.meaning: writes into a ledger or log once more

explanation.definitionFit: To re-enter is both to come back on stage and to enter details again.

clue.text: Colour I call unusual

indicators.note: something unusual is out of the ordinary, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone describes a shade they name in a strange way.
explanation.definitionFit: Lilac is a pale purple shade named after the flowering shrub.

clue.text: Where shantymen were bound to go

definitions.text: Where shantymen were bound to go

parts.words: Where shantymen were bound to go
parts.note: sea shanties sung by sailors include a famous chorus about being bound for a river in the Americas

explanation.surface: A question about the destination of singing sailors.
explanation.walkthrough: The shanty 'Rio Grande' has the line 'We're bound for the Rio Grande'; 'bound' means both heading for and obliged.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rio Grande is the river named in the refrain of a well-known capstan shanty.

clue.text: Not the winner — but should be?

definitions.text: Not the winner — but should be?

parts.words: Not the winner — but should be?
parts.note: the runner-up in a contest; the twist is that the next-best one might deserve the prize

explanation.surface: A complaint that the runner-up was robbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Second best means the runner-up, inferior to the winner.

clue.text: A natural aptitude is present

definitions.meaning: a talent one is born with

explanation.definitionFit: A gift is both an inborn talent and something given freely to someone.

clue.text: In French, France for example

parts.note: Anatole France was a writer's assumed name, and the term for it is French

explanation.surface: The country of France given as an example in French.
explanation.walkthrough: Anatole France was the pen name of the writer Jacques Thibault; nom de plume is French for pen name.
explanation.definitionFit: A nom de plume is a pen name, and France was the one chosen by Thibault.

clue.text: Tied sort of worker?

parts.note: an office worker wears a shirt and tie round the neck, rather than being tied to a job

explanation.surface: An employee who is bound to their post.
explanation.definitionFit: White-collar describes office or professional workers, who traditionally wear shirts with ties.

clue.text: Going back to living quietly

definitions.meaning: in seclusion away from the world

explanation.definitionFit: In retreat describes both an army falling back and someone in quiet seclusion.

clue.text: Made concession to be allowed in

explanation.definitionFit: Admitted means both confessed or conceded and let in.

clue.text: Useful for cracking the surface before a dip at breakfast time

definitions.text: Useful for cracking the surface before a dip at breakfast time

parts.words: Useful for cracking the surface before a dip at breakfast time
parts.note: a small utensil taps open a boiled shell, then dips in, as with toast soldiers

explanation.surface: Advice on breaking ice before a morning swim.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg spoon is a small spoon used to crack and eat a boiled egg.

clue.text: Forgotten about defect that's returned and grown worse

indicators.note: one word is placed around the other, so it surrounds it

parts.note: something forgotten is out of date, dated

indicators.note: returned means read backwards, so the word goes the other way round

parts.note: to defect is to go back on one's side, renege

explanation.surface: A forgotten turncoat who came home and went downhill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'defect' looks like a noun meaning a flaw, but it is the verb: to go back on a promise. 'that's returned' turns it round to EGENER, and 'about' wraps the forgotten word around that.
explanation.definitionFit: To degenerate is to decline or deteriorate, so degenerated means having grown worse.

clue.text: Outline of a short piece

definitions.meaning: a brief comic scene in a revue

explanation.definitionFit: A sketch is both a rough outline and a short comic performance.

clue.text: Humourless nonsense, but it could bring the house down

definitions.text: it could bring the house down

parts.note: dry means dull or lacking humour
rot is rubbish, nonsense

explanation.surface: Dull rubbish that nevertheless gets a theatre audience roaring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bring the house down' suggests a hit show, but it means literally collapsing a building through fungal decay.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry rot is a fungus that destroys timber and can make a building collapse.

clue.text: This month in Westminster

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the word Westminster

explanation.surface: Something happening at Parliament during the current month.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' picks four letters out of WestmINSTer.
explanation.definitionFit: Inst., short for instant, is the old commercial term for the present month in letters.

clue.text: Game to get down to bare essentials

definitions.text: Game to get down to bare essentials

parts.words: Game to get down to bare essentials
parts.note: a card game where losers shed clothing, getting down to what is literally bare

explanation.surface: A sport that cuts things back to their basics.
explanation.definitionFit: Strip poker is a card game in which players remove clothes when they lose.

clue.text: Problem children

explanation.definitionFit: An issue is both a point of contention and, in law, a person's offspring.

clue.text: It produces high sound, if turned on

definitions.text: It produces high sound, if turned on

indicators.note: sound means the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: the word high said aloud

indicators.note: turned means the little word is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A stereo plays treble when it is switched on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' makes HI from high, and 'turned' reverses IF to FI.
explanation.definitionFit: A hi-fi is high-fidelity audio equipment that plays music when switched on.

clue.text: Untrustworthy chaps who've been jailed more than once?

definitions.meaning: unfaithful partners who cheat on their lovers

definitions.text: who've been jailed more than once?
definitions.meaning: people who have done time twice, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: Two-timers are cheating lovers; literally the phrase suggests those who have served time twice.

clue.text: Not qualified to speak

explanation.definitionFit: Utter as an adjective means complete or unqualified; as a verb it means to say.

clue.text: He's stopping at work

parts.note: stopping is filling cavities in teeth, a job done at the surgery, not pausing

explanation.surface: Someone who is staying on at the office.
explanation.definitionFit: A dentist fills, or stops, decayed teeth as part of their job.

clue.text: Watch a marksman getting optical range

parts.note: to eye something is to watch it
a good marksman is called a shot

explanation.surface: Observing a sniper who is getting in sight.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyeshot is the distance over which one can see, the range of vision.
